exact_result: Retained domain: every reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, every dimension, every ample line bundle. BJ supplies the genuine mixed finite-energy model/intersection operator (also for ample real numerical Cartier classes), raw mass V, probability normalization, translation-normalized energy, necessary finite-dual-energy targets and uniqueness/comparison without smoothness. The exact existence theorem and onto normalization are conditional on the envelope property. A noncircular smooth affine upper-growth truncation repair and an explicit supporting barrier, local rational PL approximation and actual affine FS supporting replacement are proved. The singular norm/envelope chain is not completed; the original target is not changed or declared solved.
concrete_gaps: Wu v1 Proposition 6.12 Step 3 (LF2332-2334) uses smooth affine regularization Proposition 4.19 over F=H(s), which need not be trivially or discretely valued. The paper gives the actual unibranch cusp-product finite morphism and an irrational monomial analytic point with nondiscrete H(s). An independent arbitrary-H(s) curve regularization or local-psh norm/boundary-limit replacement is still required.

Consequently the singular upper-growth regularization theorem 6.3, weak/global identification 6.5, countable rational-polarization envelope case 7.1, and hence unconditional singular equation existence, completeness and onto normalization remain unresolved in this reconstruction. Cardinality removal and real-class passages have been checked only as conditional implications.
